newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Georg Fischer, Agie detail merger.
newsitem.headline: Georg Fischer, Agie detail merger.

text.p: Swiss engineering firm Georg Fischer AG and electroerosion machinery maker Agie Holding AG detailed a planned merger which would ultimately give Georg Fischer about 73 percent of Agie Charmilles, providing all options are exercised.

The details, released in a statement, followed an announcement in July that the firms planned to merge Fischer's Charmilles Technologies unit with Agie, to form a new company, Agie Charmilles Holding Ltd.
The new company will remain listed on the Swiss stock exchange.

The share of publically traded shares in the new Agiles Charmilles will be increased in the mid-term as George Fischer reduces its initial 73 percent stake, the companies added in the joint statement.
Agie shareholders will be asked to approve the first step towards the merger -- integrating Charmilles under Agie Holding -- at an extraordinary general meeting on October 8.

In return for giving Charmilles to Agie, a block of registered shares held by Georg Fischer will be increased to a nominal 45.1 million Swiss francs, from 35.1 million, within the framework of an ordinary capital increase.
Georg Fischer will also hold claim to receivables of 60.5 million Swiss francs.
In addition, a planned issue of Agie shareholder options will be covered by a conditional capital increase of 17.5 million Swiss francs.

Existing shareholders will receive one option per old share, entitling them to one new share for every two options held. The price and term of the exercise of the options will be announced later. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
